item.title: E01: Related Companies: From Affordable Housing to Hudson Yards to AI Data Centers
item.description: How a firm founded in 1972 with a $10,000 loan to finance affordable housing became the developer of Hudson Yards, built a vertically integrated platform with its own fund manager, and closed a $16 billion financing for an AI data center, plus who Related works with and what to know before interviewing there. Hosts are AI-generated voices; researched and scripted with AI from public sources.
